title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Venetian Theatre, Las Vegas | 2023
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Venetian Theatre in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA, on 26 May 2023.

It was the sixth show of the 15th All-Starr Band’s tour of North America, which lasted for 43 dates between May and October 2023, and the second of three nights at the Venetian Theatre.

Starr returned to the Venetian on 22, 25, 26, 29, and 31 May and 1 June 2024, and 17, 19, 20, 24, 26, and 27 September 2025.

The 15th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
